unit: Same frozen 96 synthetic exchange mothers in original and hidden-bath worlds. Report each request cross both member states and each window separately, plus combined descriptive counts.
robust_margin: For paired known margins on a request, compute max(original,changed) for each action and its minimum over the recorded nine-action catalogue.
transitions: On the development-locked primary policy, compare shared accepted actions. Count safe-to-unsafe and unsafe-to-safe and tabulate oracle feasibility category among newly unsafe requests.
lower_bound: In a hypothetical equal-probability regime for each mother, independent of the same early inputs, any forced-issue policy has expected request failure at least the per-request min over actions of the two failure indicators averaged. Also compute the mother-level failure floor for policies issuing all requests. The oracle sees both counterfactual banks, giving a stronger information set than the policy.
scope: Observational ambiguity and finite recorded catalogue, no performance or risk certificate for arbitrary mechanism shift. Do not inspect labels or alter predictions before sealing the arithmetic source.
